description.narrative: The Government of Ukraine adopted a new service delivery model for the State Employment Service SES, including a new organizational structure (Decree of the Council of Ministers #1121; https://www.kmu.gov.ua/npas/pro-realizaciyu-eksperimentalnogo-proektu-shchodo-vprovadzhennya-novoyi-modeli-nadannya-kliyentooriyentovanih-poslug-centrami-zajnyatosti-1121-281021). The new service delivery model implies more tailor-made support to PES clients, including employers, on profiling individual needs, individual employment planning, and case management approaches. The model introduced some novel professional figures in the employment offices. Beside administrators and counsellors, local SES offices now have specialized counsellors, who work with clients facing multiple and severe barriers to entering the labour market; and employers’ counsellors, who support employers in better understanding their workforce needs. The Decree of the Council of Ministers introduced also a performance management system and 42 Key performance indicators (KPIs). The implementation of the performance management system was suspended due to the war. Thanks to a financial contribution of the Government of Denmark, the ILO provided technical guidance to the SES on the design of the new service delivery model, and capacity development support on how to implement the new organizational structure. The capacity development programme relied significantly on the ILO’s facilitation of peer-learning and triangular cooperation with other public employment services (SSTC).
